1.

Let us await our God Despite the world’s scorn and threat! If the Lord is on our side, Who can stand against us? His power He grants To those who walk in His commandments, All things serve for good For those who love God.

2.

Do not strive for riches and honor In this world; Let sorrow not consume you For this brief time. It is for other battles The Lord has called you; It is for other times He has reserved your reward.

3.

Here it is a matter of working His work, who has sent us, With prayer and the Word to strengthen The life His Spirit has kindled. Here it is a matter of seeking First His righteousness, And of increasing His praise In time and eternity.
